p: Neasden Lane runs through the middle of Neasden, a short walk from Neasden station on the Jubilee line, and it's a busy road of local shops and takeaways. MERKUR is 18+ only, adults only.

Neasden's real showstopper is the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, a stunning Hindu temple carved from Bulgarian limestone and Italian marble, and visitors are welcome to look around. Wembley Stadium is close by, so expect the area to get busy on match and concert days. For some green space, Gladstone Park has great views over London, and the Welsh Harp reservoir is popular with birdwatchers and sailors.
